name: tokenflow
description: Local-first desktop analytics for Ollama and DeepSeek usage
author: Siddhesh Gunjal

scripts.bundle:linux:x64: npm run version:sync && tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles deb,rpm,appimage
scripts.bundle:linux:arm64: npm run version:sync && tauri build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles deb,rpm,appimage
scripts.bundle:windows:x64: npm run version:sync && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.bundle:windows:arm64: npm run version:sync && tauri build --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.bundle:macos:x64: npm run version:sync && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles dmg
scripts.bundle:macos:arm64: npm run version:sync && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles dmg
